Cowdery’s narrative began where Joseph’s 1832 account ended. Joseph Smith, Oliver Cowdery, and John Whitmer may have assumed responsibility for the different episodes outlined in Joseph’s prospectus, with Joseph taking the first two (to which only he was a witness), Cowdery the third (at which he was also present), and John Whitmer (a later Church historian) the fourth (seeHistorical Introduction, “History, circa Summer 1832”).
